description: This file defines the Zone class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace, handling zone-related events such as add, edit, and delete zone, and generating tasks for country info updates.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class handling zone-related events in the admin panel, including adding, editing, and deleting zones, and scheduling country info update tasks.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a zone, schedules a task to update country info based on the new zone.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Handles the event of editing a zone, schedules tasks to update country info, including handling country switch scenarios.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Handles the event of deleting a zone, schedules a task to update country info accordingly.
